unlisted_practices: Multi-agent LLM framework with Reflexion-style verbal self-reflection to self-correct answers
Combining retrieval-augmented generation with multi-agent task planning for otolaryngology question answering

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel multi-agent LLM framework (ENTAgents) with RAG and verbal reinforcement learning on medical otolaryngology exam questions. It evaluates system-level architecture/model performance rather than organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
